BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Energy, Environment & Telecommunications (originally sponsored by Senators Honeyford, Sheldon, and Ericksen)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax exemption for environmental handling charges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a business and occupation tax exemption for environmental handling charges; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and creating a new section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a producer, retailer, or stewardship organization for an environmental handling charge that is:
(a) Added to the purchase price of mercury-containing lights by a producer, retailer, or a retailer under an agreement with the producer as authorized under RCW 70.275.050;
(b) Retained by a retailer as reimbursement for any costs associated with the collection and remittance of an environmental handling charge; or
(c) Received by a stewardship organization from a producer or retailer.
(2) For the purposes of this section, "environmental handling charge" and "mercury-containing lights" have the same meanings as provided in RCW 70.275.020.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act is not subject to the requirements of RCW 82.32.805 and 82.32.808. This act is not subject to an expiration date.
